issue.title: Stabilize @-prefix directory drilldown test under suite load
issue.description: The approved open-task audit baseline on 2026-08-02 found tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_at_prefix_completion.py::TestAtPrefixIntegration::test_at_prefix_directory_drilldown failing under the full parallel just test suite and passing immediately in isolation in 5.40s. Re-verification on master 5143cb981 did not reproduce it in the six-worker full suite (25,391 passed, 7 skipped, with only two unrelated failures), while the exact node passed alone again in 8.23s with a 0.71s call. Searches across every task status for at_prefix, directory_drilldown, directory drilldown, and prompt at prefix found no match. Active epic sase-e9 is scoped to suite-gate integration budgets and PNG animation convergence, so it has no credible causal link. Diagnose and remove the xdist/load timing dependence in @-prefix directory drilldown completion while preserving the real asynchronous completion behavior.
